name: Collect-A-Con Orlando
blurb: Orlando stop of the multi-city Collect-A-Con tour: trading cards, pop-culture collectibles, cosplay and celebrity autograph signings at the Orange County Convention Center.
notes: The evergreen /orlando/ URL currently redirects to 'Orlando 2026 Recap' ('Thank you for attending! See you next year.'), confirming that show already completed; no next Orlando date is shown. Checked the site's XML sitemap for any schedule/tour page or 2027-dated URL across the whole domain and found none, so no Orlando edition is announced yet. Exact last-edition dates (May 23-24, 2026) are not restated on the official recap page itself (title only) but are corroborated by several independent event-listing sites (thecardshopfinder.com, cardshowdex.com, rostercon.com). The recap page's own og image and hero carousel are a generic crowd photo and a cross-promo for the next tour stop (Dallas), not Orlando-specific, so the cover instead uses the branded 'CITIES BRANDING ORLANDO' key art from the most recent dated Orlando page (/orlando-2024/), which is still linked from the site and is the best official art representing this stop.
